items.quoted_clause: At the canonical peak of 40 rps, fleet size must satisfy **both** the KV-residency and the throughput/latency bounds *and whichever binds first*. items.evidence: chapter-05.md §3(b) (exact): 'the effective cost is ~0.40 $/tok/s, or equivalently ~2.5 (tok/s) per dollar‑per‑hour of budget'. Inputs from Table 5-1: 'Tokens per dollar (generation, runtime) | 9,000 tokens per dollar | 50 tok/s × 3600 s/hr ÷ $20/hr' — so $20/hr ÷ 50 tok/s = $0.40 per (tok/s) per hour ✓; per token: $20/(50 × 3600) = $0.000111 ✓ (3,600× ✓). The primary unit '$0.40 $/tok/s' omits the time basis that the reciprocal form carries ('per dollar-per-hour'); read as ($/tok)/s it is off by a factor of 3,600.
